name: APEX-043-25 HealthGuard Patient Data Breach
description: 5步医疗数据泄露：GraphQL introspection 暴露隐藏类型，深度滥用提取存储凭据，FHIR 搜索 SQL injection 导出患者数据，Go DICOM 查看器中的双重编码路径遍历读取内部文件，MinIO 访问窃取受限医疗记录
hint: GraphQL endpoint does not restrict introspection and deep queries, hidden types expose stored credentials, and the search interface has injection vulnerabilities.
objective: Breach healthcare system to access restricted patient records containing flag

description.en: 5-step healthcare data breach: GraphQL introspection reveals hidden types, depth abuse extracts storage credentials, FHIR search SQL injection dumps patient data, double-encoded path traversal in Go DICOM viewer reads internal files, MinIO access exfiltrates restricted medical records

hint.en: GraphQL端点未限制内省和深度查询，隐藏类型中暴露了存储凭据，搜索接口存在注入
